reason: Expert advice to replace a suspected bad SFP failed, showing that port up with optical levels ok but zero traffic can persist even after multiple SFP replacements.

knowledge.summary: Replacing an SFP when port is up and optics are ok but traffic counters remain at zero may fail to resolve the issue, as multiple consecutive SFPs can exhibit the same behavior.
knowledge.author: Tiina Tuominen
knowledge.details: Port is up and optics ok, but counters at zero after replacing SFP twice.
